end.summary: Defined food miles as the distance food travels from farm to home.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised comparing food distances and linking longer journeys with more fuel, pollution, refrigeration, and less freshness. They used local and seasonal foods as ways to reduce food miles and discussed exceptions when a food is not available nearby. One mix-up remained: they associated food from far away with being special or more nutritious; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, compare two foods and discuss which travelled farther and what local or seasonal alternative could be chosen.
